# Orion Hall

Orion Hall is a fictional venue that exists only in this synthetic test corpus.

## Capacity

Orion Hall seats up to 120 guests in theatre layout and 80 guests in banquet layout.

## Cancellation Policy

A booking at Orion Hall can be cancelled free of charge up to 14 days before the event. Cancellations inside 14 days forfeit the deposit.

## Catering

Orion Hall offers in-house vegetarian catering and allows approved external caterers.
